next_hypothesis.name: trend.continuous_signal
next_hypothesis.hypothesis: A continuous trend-strength signal (trailing-return t-statistic, Baltas-Kosowski) cuts round-trip turnover by >=25% vs the binary multiscale sign signal with net Sharpe no worse, on the deployed long-only 1x config
next_hypothesis.criteria: SUPPORTED only if TEST-period turnover falls >=25% AND net Sharpe difference (continuous minus binary) is not negative by more than 1 SE AND the turnover reduction clears the adjusted bar; 70/30 time split, deployed config

rules: Live P&L can raise an alarm; it can never promote a change.
The significance bar rises with every hypothesis ever tested.
Dead ideas are never retested without genuinely new data.
Promotion requires pre-registration, holdout and beating the null.
Demotion is automatic when a supported finding stops clearing the bar.
